items.title: CNA's international division reports 6% premium growth and 86.1% combined ratio
items.summary: CNA Financial's international segment posted a stronger third-quarter combined ratio of 86.1%, driven by favorable reserve development, even as the parent company faced domestic pressure.

items.title: Coface increases credit limit cuts as corporate defaults and large claims rise
items.summary: Trade credit insurer Coface stepped up buyer limit reductions during the third quarter as high corporate defaults and returning large claims reduced net income by 11.8%.

items.title: Intact Insurance adds Guardian Group and Ceylinco to global network
items.summary: Intact Insurance expanded its multinational network to over 170 countries by adding Guardian Group in the Caribbean and Ceylinco Insurance in the Maldives.

items.title: Supermarket refrigeration cyberattacks expose property and cyber cover gaps
items.summary: A second wave of cyberattacks targeting supermarket refrigeration across Europe highlights potential gaps between cyber and property insurance policies.

items.title: AXA Commercial appoints Carolyn Rich and launches partner leadership scheme
items.summary: AXA Commercial has hired Carolyn Rich as marketing and broker development director while its delegated authority business runs an emerging leaders programme.

items.title: MGAA opens membership to international managing general agents
items.summary: The MGAA has opened its membership to eligible managing general agents, insurers and suppliers based outside the UK and Ireland.
